text:
kevin: starting config-only rollout now — tiny-slice geo-split + routing weight tweak + shorter timeout. deploy-bot: https://deploys.redwood.internal/5832104321 :rocket:
sara: change window 22:00-23:00 PT. plan: 0.2% us-west-2 + 0.2% eu-west-1 (separate cohorts). model pinned to v2.3.1 for 36h. no binaries.
deploy-bot: rollout initiated: stage=canary cohorts=[us-west-2:0.2,eu-west-1:0.2] config=cfg/2026-03-21/geo-split-tight.json
kevin: exact params — request_timeout_ms 1200->950, max_batch_size 68->44, batching_window_ms 24->12, routing_weight_dedicated +8% under CPU>70%.
frank: tiny-slice across two regions is safer. watch cross-region routing consistency. add auto-rollback: errors>0.5% OR p99>baseline*1.35 sustained 5m OR routing_fallback_rate>2% sustained 4m.
sara: applied autobackout rules and attached runbook: https://wiki.redwood/ops/config-rollbacks. pager to #eng-oncall. yaml excerpt below:
```yaml
cohorts:
  - region: us-west-2
    pct: 0.2
  - region: eu-west-1
    pct: 0.2
limits:
  max_batch_size: 44
  request_timeout_ms: 950
batching_window_ms: 12
routing:
  bias_to_dedicated_pct_under_load: 8
```
deploy-bot: canaries applied, health checks running.
infra-alert-bot: initial metrics us-west-2 -> p50=112ms p95=305ms p99=530ms errors=0.03% cost_delta=-0.5%; eu-west-1 -> p50=120ms p95=320ms p99=560ms errors=0.04% cost_delta=-0.6%.
frank: eu p99 a bit higher — baseline?
kevin: baseline eu p99 ~540ms, so +3.7% OK. continue but keep kv-store ops on watch.
sara: adding kv_ops alert: kv_ops_increase>15% sustained 6m triggers rollback.
frank: also add synthetic probe for routing determinism; if routing_mismatch_rate>0.5% pause rollout.
sara: synthetic probe added. deploy-bot: auto-rollback rules and probes registered. next step: advance to 1% per region after 12m if stable.
infra-alert-bot: alerting wired to #eng-oncall + ops pager. notification thresholds documented in runbook.
kevin: release note (short): "Config-only: tighten request timeout to 950ms, reduce max_batch_size to 44, shorten batching window to 12ms, bias routing to dedicated under load (+8%). Canary tiny-slice split across us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Model pinned v2.3.1 for 36h. Auto-rollback on error/p99/kv/routing mismatch thresholds"
sara: canary stable at 0.2% per region after 10m. eu p95 +5ms, errors stable. advancing to 1% per region in 10m.
frank: oncall acknowledged. will escalate if any auto-rollback triggers.
kevin: thanks — will post final when fully rolled or if rollback occurs. :thumbsup:
